ignore_sites.description: Match patterns where DesertFox starts in ignore mode

which_key_border.description: Corner style of the which-key panel border

mode_indicator.description: When the mode badge shows: always (NORMAL too), not_normal, or off

theme.description: Theme name: themes/<name>.toml in the config directory first, then a built-in theme. Light or dark follows the system theme

light_intensity.description: Which of the five light sets of an Oasis theme the light variant uses, 1 (lightest) to 5

home_page.description: URL that page.home opens, or "desertfox" for the built-in new tab page

default_engine.description: Search engine that open.clipboard uses for text that is not a URL. Must name a defined engine

new_tab_page.description: What a new tab shows: an http or https URL that the new tab redirects to, or "desertfox" for the built-in page. Unset means the built-in page

completion_all_windows.description: Whether the tab completion lists the tabs of every window, not only the line's window

cmdline_prompt.description: Before the command line input: "caret" for a bold > , "colon" for a primary-colored :, or your own text (include the trailing space you want)

open_completion.description: Groups that open completes from, in list order. A source left out is not read. Default is both

history_completion_max.description: History rows that open completion shows for an empty word

newtab_clock.description: The new tab page clock: false hides it, true or "analog" shows the analog face, "digital" shows the seven-segment digits

newtab_date.description: Whether the new tab page shows the date under the clock

newtab_clock_format.description: Hours on the digital clock: 12 with an AM or PM suffix, or 24. The analog clock ignores it

newtab_bookmarks.description: Whether the new tab page lists your bookmarks, newest added first

newtab_bookmarks_max.description: Bookmark rows on the new tab page

newtab_recent_tabs.description: Whether the new tab page lists your open tabs, last used first. Private tabs never show

newtab_recent_tabs_max.description: Recent tab rows on the new tab page

newtab_links.description: Links on the new tab page, one [[newtab_links]] table each. Links with the same group share a list

open_quick_start_on_install.description: Whether the first install opens the Quick Start page. A first install has no config yet, so this helps managed setups, which carry the config from the start
